deep_run_2026_09_11.purpose: Search beyond the current research queue for independent practical mechanisms, deduplicate them against Brali, and build new discovery surfaces without lowering evidence standards.
new_source_screened_candidates: Grayscale smartphone friction for reducing screen time
Nature break framed primarily as a mood reset
Daily steps as a possible sleep-support habit
Social-interaction intervention cluster that still needs decomposition
corrective_findings: Do not present a complete social-media detox as a universal wellbeing intervention.
Do not promise a large cognitive benefit from merely moving a phone out of sight.
Do not sell nature exposure as a reliable cognition booster when mood evidence is stronger.
Do not turn small average gratitude effects into a happiness-transformation claim.
Do not invent one optimal movement-break schedule from low-certainty heterogeneous cognition evidence.
deep_run_2026_09_11.development_zone_candidate: Digital Attention is strong enough for a future dedicated hub, but the current public hub contract is intentionally fixed at seven. It remains an existing ontology Topic and a Focus-related surface for now.

fresh_external_scan.title: Efficacy of a self-guided online resilience intervention for improving mental health among university students: A randomized controlled trial
fresh_external_scan.reason: The per-protocol analysis showed some improvements, but adherence was low and the intention-to-treat analysis found no significant effects. This is useful negative/boundary evidence, not a basis for a general self-guided resilience protocol.

fresh_external_scan.title: Encouraging Growth in Programming Education: Does Growth Mindset Feedback Influence Learning?
fresh_external_scan.reason: In a controlled study of 79 German secondary-school students, feedback type showed no main effect on performance, mindset beliefs, self-efficacy, attempts, or give-up behavior. The narrow sample prevents broad conclusions, but the result argues against treating growth-mindset wording as a default feedback upgrade.

fresh_external_scan.title: Mindfulness, creative self-efficacy, and communal-agentic orientation in human–AI decision-making with implications for adaptive AI design
fresh_external_scan.reason: The study is relevant to human-AI decision calibration but is observational: it links individual traits with whether professionals revise a budget allocation after AI input. It cannot justify a causal delegation or calibration protocol.

fresh_external_scan.title: Effects of mobile application-based exercises compared with traditional exercise on pain and work functioning in academicians: a quasi-experimental study
fresh_external_scan.reason: The study is small, quasi-experimental, institution-allocated, and combines exercise with ergonomic education. It is too context-specific and causally weak to justify another Brali movement protocol beyond the existing stronger evidence base.

rules: Search the previous calendar month, not an arbitrary rolling window, for the digest layer.
Keep discovery, source review, and protocol promotion as separate states.
Record negative and null findings when they constrain Brali claims.
Prefer strengthening or challenging an existing protocol over creating a near-duplicate.
Report what was reviewed, what changed, what was rejected or held, and why.

note: Partial September digest through 2026-09-11 inclusive. Deep Run candidates are a screening layer and are not canonical trusted evidence until a full-source Evidence Review is completed. The requested ceiling of 50 was treated as a ceiling, not a quota; near-duplicates and weak ideas were intentionally not promoted.
